_comment: Edition registry for the Electrical app. Each PDF in this folder belongs to one source (edition). Files not listed here are auto-detected at build time: year/publication from the foreword, or matched to a listed edition by printed page number + circuit title.

sources.title: 1990 Celica All-Trac/4WD Electrical Wiring Diagram
sources.note: ST185 only. A/C chapters cover the push-button blower control only.

sources.title: 1992 Celica Electrical Wiring Diagram
sources.note: Transition year: covers both push-button and dial blower controls. Adds Convertible, Top Stack, Shift Lock, ECT and Electric Tension Reducer circuits.

sources.title: 1993 Celica Electrical Wiring Diagram (per-circuit pulls)
sources.note: Individual circuits pulled from Toyota TIS. Edition inferred: no Convertible/Top Stack coverage (1993 dropped the convertible), dial blower control, and page numbering that differs from the 1990 and 1992 books.

sources.title: 1993 Celica Service Manual — electrical articles and wiring diagrams (aftermarket)
sources.note: Mitchell-style aftermarket manual for all 1993 Celicas: diagnosis, testing and removal for each electrical system plus system and overall wiring diagrams. Fills the circuits missing from the 1993 TIS pulls.

sources.title: Reference documents (gt4.mwp.id.au)
sources.note: Enthusiast and Toyota general references: 3S-GTE ECU pinouts, alternator theory, and Toyota's Wire Harness Repair Manual (connector and terminal repair).
